import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141218e30")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent at 0x141218e30")
out["name"]=str(f.getName()); out["body"]=str(f.getBody()); out["signature"]=str(f.getSignature())
# try decompile with longer timeout and fallback to pcode sample
results = {}
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 300, monitor)
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        out["error"]=str(res.getErrorMessage())
    else:
        out["decompiled"]=res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
finally:
    d.dispose()
print(json.dumps(out))
